entries.visual_context: A newspaper job advertisement with listings circled.
entries.semantic_meaning: advertisement for an available job

entries.visual_context: A blank form with fields to complete.
entries.semantic_meaning: form used to apply for a job

entries.visual_context: A letter and résumé in an envelope.
entries.semantic_meaning: letter sent with a job application

entries.visual_context: A folder containing examples of work.
entries.semantic_meaning: collection of work samples

entries.visual_context: Two people reviewing a document with a photograph and employment details.
entries.semantic_meaning: document summarizing a person's education and work experience

entries.visual_context: A recruiter sits with a job applicant and completes a form.
entries.semantic_meaning: person or organization that finds candidates for jobs

entries.visual_context: Pointer to the form being completed by the recruiter and applicant.
entries.semantic_meaning: to complete a form by writing required information

entries.source_text: What kind of work are you looking for?
entries.visual_context: Speech bubble from the recruiter speaking to an applicant.
entries.semantic_meaning: question about the type of job wanted

entries.visual_context: A person uses a computer to submit an application.
entries.semantic_meaning: to formally request a job

entries.visual_context: Pointer to job listings on a computer screen.
entries.semantic_meaning: available jobs

entries.visual_context: A candidate and interviewer sit across a desk.
entries.semantic_meaning: to meet an employer to discuss a job application

entries.source_text: What makes you the perfect candidate for this job?
entries.visual_context: Speech bubble from the interviewer during the interview.
entries.semantic_meaning: interview question about suitability for a job

entries.source_text: I’m hardworking and I’m a team player.
entries.visual_context: Speech bubble from the job candidate during the interview.
entries.semantic_meaning: statement describing positive workplace qualities

entries.visual_context: Three people working together around a table.
entries.semantic_meaning: to work together with others

entries.visual_context: Two people organize tasks on a planning board.
entries.semantic_meaning: to organize people or activities so they work effectively together

entries.visual_context: Two people talk while one holds a pitchfork, with a chicken beside them.
entries.semantic_meaning: to discuss in order to reach an agreement

entries.visual_context: People raise their hands to offer help.
entries.semantic_meaning: to offer to do something willingly

entries.visual_context: One worker directs and observes two other workers.
entries.semantic_meaning: to oversee the work of others

entries.visual_context: A manager directs staff members.
entries.semantic_meaning: to be responsible for controlling or organizing work

entries.visual_context: Two people work at a table beside a clock.
entries.semantic_meaning: to complete work by a required time

entries.visual_context: A worker holds a clipboard or document.
entries.semantic_meaning: to arrange or plan things systematically

entries.visual_context: Pointer to the tall green worker overseeing the group.
entries.semantic_meaning: person who supervises workers

entries.visual_context: Pointer to the striped work document held by the supervisor.
entries.semantic_meaning: document listing work tasks or instructions

entries.visual_context: Pointer to the smaller blue worker in the group.
entries.semantic_meaning: person learning a skilled job from an experienced worker

entries.visual_context: Pointer to the orange worker leading the group.
entries.semantic_meaning: person responsible for leading a team

entries.visual_context: Pointer to the blue worker beside the team leader.
entries.semantic_meaning: person who works with another person

entries.visual_context: A man and woman shake hands after a successful job application.
entries.semantic_meaning: to be offered or obtain the job

entries.visual_context: Pointer to the hands of two people greeting each other.
entries.semantic_meaning: to greet or agree by clasping hands

entries.source_text: Welcome to the company. We are looking forward to working with you.
entries.visual_context: Speech bubble from the man welcoming the new employee.
entries.semantic_meaning: welcome given after someone gets a job

entries.visual_context: A person signs a document at a desk.
entries.semantic_meaning: to write one's signature on a legal agreement

entries.visual_context: Pointer to the document being signed.
entries.semantic_meaning: legal written agreement

entries.source_text: I can’t wait to get started.
entries.visual_context: Speech bubble from the new employee signing the contract.
entries.semantic_meaning: expression of eagerness to begin work
